prompts.title: Drop plan
prompts.summary: Plans one drop from a list of pieces: the order they go live, a post for each and the email.
prompts.prompt:
I run [boutique], a clothing boutique for [who]. This week's drop: [list each piece with color, sizes and price].

Plan the drop:
1. The order the pieces go live and why (lead with the one most people will want).
2. One post idea per piece: what to film, the first line of the caption.
3. The drop email: subject line, three short paragraphs, one button.
4. A restock note for anything with fewer than [n] in a size.

Keep it in my voice: [paste a caption you wrote].
prompts.use: Run it on Sunday night with your list. Post the lead piece first.

prompts.title: Fit notes for a piece
prompts.summary: Writes honest fit notes from your measurements and how the piece wore on you or a model.
prompts.prompt:
Write fit notes for the [piece] from [boutique].

Facts: fabric [ ], stretch [none/some/a lot], length on a [height] model wearing size [ ], measurements per size [paste], how it fit when we tried it [your words].

Give: "How it fits" in three short lines, "Size up or down?" in one line, and care in one line. Plain words. Never "flattering on every body".
prompts.use: Paste the output under the product photos. Fit notes cut the returns that come from guessing.

prompts.title: Try-on reel brief
prompts.summary: One outfit styled three ways, as a 20-second reel with the first second and the shot order.
prompts.prompt: Write a 20-second try-on reel brief for the [piece] from [boutique]. Style it three ways: [occasions]. Include the first second (the piece moving, not a title card), the shot order, where to stand for light, on-screen words (five per look at most), and the caption with the price and sizes left.
prompts.use: Film it in one take per look in the fitting room. Post the day the piece goes live.
